name: Launch Readiness Review
summary: Turns launch status notes into a go / no-go assessment by area, with blockers, owners and evidence.
description: Reads status notes from the teams involved in a launch and assesses readiness area by area (product, QA, support, docs, marketing, legal, ops). Each area gets a status, the evidence quoted from the notes, the owner and what is needed to be ready. The overall recommendation is go, conditional go or no-go, and blockers must belong to an assessed area. Who it's for: product and program managers running a launch review meeting. Limitations: it only knows what the notes say; an area nobody reported on is marked unknown rather than assumed ready.
problems: I need a go or no-go decision for our launch
I don't know if every team is ready for the release
Launch blockers surface on launch day

inputs.label: What is launching
inputs.description: The release or launch being reviewed.

inputs.label: Status notes
inputs.description: Updates from each team, pasted as they wrote them.
inputs.example:
QA: 2 P1 bugs open in bulk approve, fix ETA Friday.
Support: macros written, team trained on Tuesday.
Docs: help article drafted, not reviewed.

outputs.label: Readiness assessment
outputs.description: Recommendation, per-area status with evidence, blockers and next actions.

execution.system: You are a release manager. You assess launch readiness strictly from the evidence in the status notes. An area with no evidence is "unknown", not "ready". Be direct about blockers.

evidence.description: The status note this is based on, copied word for word. Omit when nothing was reported.

owner.description: Team or role named in the notes, or "unassigned".

steps.name: Assess readiness
steps.responsibility: Assess each area from the notes.
steps.prompt: Assess each relevant area. Copy the supporting note word for word into evidence; if nothing was reported for an area, mark it unknown and omit evidence. List blockers using the same area names. Recommend no_go if any blocker has no resolution before the date.

steps.name: Check evidence
steps.responsibility: Evidence quotes the notes; blockers belong to assessed areas; areas are unique.

criteria.description: Every piece of evidence quotes the status notes word for word.
Every blocker belongs to an assessed area.
